{{Quote|I always wanted to design buildings, but never had the motivation to take the steps necessary to actually become an architect. Instead, I do paintings of buildings. Not quite the same thing, but I find it satisfying.|Kolka Zteht, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Kolka Zteht''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Zteht resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where she created two works of art, titled ''[[Blue Leaf Temple]]'' and ''[[Residential House]]''. Both of these [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] were subsequently featured in the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]] by curator [[Lilas Dinhint]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Where will I find Kolka Zteht?"<br />"Look near the back of the theater in Mos Entha to find Kolka Zteht.|A spacer and Lilas Dinhint|<ref name="SWG" />}}
[[File:KolkaZteht2.png|thumb|left|250px|Kolka Zteht setting up shop on Tatooine]]
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] by the name of Kolka Zteht lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She originally had aspirations of becoming an [[Architect/Legends|architect]], but she believed that she lacked the motivation to actually learn how to be one. Instead, she settled on becoming an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who simply created [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] of buildings, a pastime she found to be satisfying.<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Zteht set up shop near the [[Mos Entha theater|theater]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While there, she created two paintings, one simply titled ''[[Residential House]]'', which depicted a small home, and another titled ''[[Blue Leaf Temple]]'', which depicted the [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG" />

Meanwhile, in Tatooine's Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], curator [[Lilas Dinhint]] oversaw the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]],<ref name="SWG" /> which served as the planet's only [[Museum/Legends|museum]].<ref name="Eisley">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref> Dinhint sought to enhance the museum's collection by offering visitors something new. To that end, the museum selected a small number of artists who would be approached for an opportunity to have their art featured in Bestine. Kolka Zteht was one of the artists to be considered, along with [[Vanvi Hotne]], [[Giaal Itotr]], [[Klepa Laeel]], [[Kahfr Oladi]], and [[Boulo Siesi]]. In order to have her paintings featured in Bestine, however, Zteht required enough votes to win over her fellow artists. Lilas Dinhint held a Bestine Museum art competition every thirty [[Standard day/Legends|days]], allowing for a period of fifteen days in between in which individuals could vote for their favorite artist.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
During the course of her artistry career, Zteht was approached by a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], many of whom voted for her as their artist of choice. Zteht won the art competitions at various times, allowing her the opportunity to display her paintings in Bestine's museum for a period of thirty days. During the time her paintings were displayed, the corrupt curator Dinhint offered schematics of the artworks in exchange for a "modest donation" of 48,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. This allowed the opportunity for architecturally-inclined furniture makers and [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] to mass-produce copies of Zteht's paintings so that they could be purchased, [[Collector/Legends|collected]], or displayed for personal use.<ref name="SWG" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Blue-leaf-temple.jpg|150px|thumb|''Blue Leaf Temple'']]
{{Quote|Hello Friend. ''[sic]'' Slow down a bit and enjoy the day.|Kolka Zteht to a passerby|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Kolka Zteht had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin, auburn [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and purple-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Although she was a capable artist, Zteht lacked the motivation to pursue her original goal of becoming an architect. However, she found the act of simply painting buildings to be enough of a satisfying pursuit. Zteht had a friendly demeanor, and leisurely outlook on life, at times encouraging passersby to slow down and enjoy the day, or to sit down with her and have a drink. Zteht strove to be humble, but she had never felt prouder than when her artwork was put up for display in Bestine.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
[[File:Residential-house.jpg|150px|thumb|''Residential House'']]
{{Quote|Hello. Did you know I have a painting in the Bestine Museum? It's true. I'm trying to be humble, but I've never been so proud of myself."<br />"You should be proud."<br />"Thank you. I encourage you to go see my painting. I did mention that it's in the Bestine Museum, yes?|Kola Zteht and a passerby|<ref name="SWG" />}}
During her time as an artist in Mos Entha, Zteht wore a blue frock with a white [[Belt/Legends|belt]], and a pair of blue women's shoes. In creating her paintings, Zteht used a couple art palettes. She also had among her personal effects a brown satchel.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kolka Zteht was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was added to the game on [[February 11]], [[2004]] as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 6 Notes: 11 February 04|Publish 6 The Imperial Crackdown]]. The update featured a new [[W:c:swg:Bestine Painting Election|Bestine Museum event]], in which players could vote for a number of NPC artists in order to have one of their paintings put up for display in the [[W:c:swg:Bestine Museum|museum]].<ref name="Publish 6">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60893|text=Publish 6: The Imperial Crackdown}}</ref> Kolka Zteht was one of these artists, and players who chose to vote for her were required to first converse with her in [[W:c:swg:Mos Entha|Mos Entha]]. If Zteht got the most votes, one of her paintings, either [[W:c:swg:Painting of a Residential House|''Residential House'']] or [[W:c:swg:Painting of the Blue Leaf Temple|''Blue Leaf Temple'']], would be displayed for about a one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] period, and players could purchase [[W:c:swg:Schematic|schematics]] of the paintings during a two [[Standard week/Legends|week]] period for a fee of 48,000 [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credits]]. The winning artist depended on the player's input, however as the competitions were held monthly, this article assumes 100% game completion, and that Kolka Zteht won the right to display both of her paintings on at least several occasions.<ref name="SWG" />
